verdict.rationale: Trello's own features cover part of the story: checklist items with due dates can serve as subtasks, and a 'Link cards' capability is listed. Nothing shows dependency or blocking relationships, or any way to see blocking order, so the dependency half is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented dependency/blocking link types between cards, a visualization of blocking order, explicit subtask docs beyond a checklist mention, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: Set due dates for checklist items
it took 6-7 clicks to reach a checklist
